Name: Electric Furnace and Carbon Fiber
Author: strobel1ght
Description:
Why are we still using Coal for smelting ores in the 21st century? It's time to upgrade.

You can purchase the recipe for the [b]Electric Furnace [/b]from the [b]Dwarf[/b] whenever you are able to purchase items from him.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wPBNbFQ.png[/img]
To craft an [b]Electric Furnace[/b], you require
[list]
[*]50 Stones
[*]1 Carbon Fiber
[*]1 Battery Pack
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RLfzWgi.png[/img]﻿
[b]Carbon Fiber[/b] can be produced by adding these ingredients to the loom.
[list]
[*]1 Cloth
[*]1 Coal
[/list]--------------------------------

—Mod Prerequisites—
﻿- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Mod Framework[/url]﻿

—Installation—
Place the entire unzipped folder Electric Furnace and Carbon Fiber into /Mods
